terms.subtitle: Five pillars of agreement between Sinari Cell and the Customer to ensure a secure, comfortable, and hassle-free transaction.

01.title: Registration & Diagnostic Fees
01.desc: We do not charge diagnostic fees. However, if the service is canceled after you have approved the cost (and the device has been disassembled), a minimum reassembly fee will apply. Special parts ordering requires a 50% down payment.

02.title: Transaction Payments
02.desc: Repaired or purchased items must be paid in full before being taken home. We do not accept personal credit or installment systems. Valid payments are made at the store cashier or via corporate bank transfer.

03.title: Device Collection Limit
03.desc: Devices must be collected within a maximum of 30 Days after being confirmed as completed or canceled. After 90 days with no communication, the item is considered abandoned, and we reserve the right to auction it to cover our losses.

04.title: Hardware Repair Risks
04.desc: Units brought in with a history of being completely dead, liquid-damaged, or requiring IC/CPU repairs carry a risk of permanent failure or loss of certain features after disassembly. Our technicians work to the best of their abilities, but these risks are fully borne by the customer.

05.title: Final Inspection (Handover)
05.desc: Customers are required to physically inspect the screen, camera, and other accessories before leaving the counter. Complaints regarding cracks, scratches, or missing items after leaving the store premises are considered invalid.

privacy.title: Privacy & Data Security
privacy.subtitle: We protect your personal data as carefully as we repair your devices.

01.title: Information We Collect
01.desc: We only request your Full Name, WhatsApp Number, and damage details for registration purposes. We will never ask for your ID card unless required to verify device ownership due to a lost receipt.

02.title: Password Confidentiality
02.desc: Your screen password or pattern is only requested if comprehensive hardware testing is necessary (e.g., full screen or audio tests). You reserve the right to decline, which may result in limited post-repair testing warranties.

03.title: Strict Data Access Prohibition
03.desc: Sinari Cell's Standard Operating Procedures strictly forbid technicians from opening customer messaging apps, photo galleries, or mobile banking. Any privacy violation by our staff will face severe legal action.

04.title: Third Parties & Marketing
04.desc: Your phone number is strictly used within our internal database for receipt tracking and after-sales service. We absolutely do not sell or share customer data with any telemarketing agencies.

05.title: Use of Cookies
05.desc: The Sinari Cell website uses minimal essential Cookies strictly to maintain your active login session (Login Token). We do not use third-party cookies to track your browsing activities for advertising purposes.

delete_data.title: Delete Your Data
delete_data.desc: You have the absolute right to request the permanent deletion of your phone number and service history from our system once the warranty period has expired.
delete_data.email_body:
Hello Sinari Cell Team,

In accordance with the applicable privacy policy, I would like to request the anonymization of my personal data (masking my Name and WhatsApp Number) from the store's service history system.

Here are my transaction details for verification purposes:

Service ID (SRV) :
Customer Name :
Registered WA Number :

Please confirm via this email once my identity data has been successfully deleted/masked from the database.

Thank you for your assistance.

warranty.title: Warranty Policy
warranty.subtitle: Transparent from the start. Know your rights and how to keep your device's warranty valid.

valid.title: Valid Warranty
valid.desc: Sinari Cell will repair or replace parts free of charge if:

list.01: The damage occurs on the exact same component that was previously repaired.
list.02: The claim is made within the warranty period (calculated from the day the device was picked up).
list.03: You bring the original service receipt and provide evidence of the issue (if any).

void.title: Void Warranty
void.desc: Warranty claims will be rejected, and any further repairs will be charged at standard rates if:

list.01: Broken store seal: The warranty seal is torn, missing, or shows signs of tampering.
list.02: Human Error: The device is dropped, bumped, crushed in a pocket, physically damaged, or exposed to liquid or sweat.
list.03: Third-party intervention: The device has been repaired at another store after leaving Sinari Cell.

claim.title: How to Claim
claim.desc: Bring your device and the original receipt, and show the issue to our technicians.

faq.title: Sinari Cell FAQ
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our services, warranties, and operational procedures.

list.question: How long does the repair process take?
list.answer: Minor repairs can be done while you wait (1-2 hours). For major hardware or motherboard issues, the estimated time is 1-3 business days.

list.question: Do you provide a warranty after the repair?
list.answer: Yes, we offer a 30-day warranty for parts replacement and repair services, provided the warranty seal remains intact.

list.question: How can I track my device's repair status?
list.answer: Please use the 'Track Repair Status' feature in the top menu and enter the Receipt ID provided by the cashier to monitor the progress in real-time.

list.question: What payment methods are accepted?
list.answer: Our payment methods are highly flexible. We accept Cash, Bank Transfers (BCA, Mandiri), and QRIS (Gopay, OVO, DANA, etc.).

list.question: Is my personal data secure?
list.answer: Absolutely. Our technicians are strictly prohibited from accessing your gallery, messages, or other personal data without your permission. Your privacy is our priority.

list.question: Is there a fee for the initial consultation?
list.answer: Not at all. Initial diagnostics and consultations regarding your device's issues, whether in-store or via WhatsApp, are completely free of charge.
